scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run build:server && tsc -p tsconfig.client.test.json && node --test "dist/lib/**/*.test.js" "dist/client-tests/client/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:server && tsc -p tsconfig.client.test.json && node --test --experimental-test-coverage "dist/lib/**/*.test.js" "dist/client-tests/client/**/*.test.js"
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start
